name: Interview (面试)
description: Interview record: questions asked, answers given, and an assessment.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: Give a one-paragraph overview: who was interviewed for what role or program, and the overall impression.

sections.title: Questions and Answers
sections.instruction: List each substantive question asked and a concise summary of the answer given, in order.
sections.item_format:
| Question | Answer Summary | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Strengths
sections.instruction: List strengths demonstrated during the interview, with evidence from the transcript.

sections.title: Concerns
sections.instruction: List weaknesses, gaps, or open concerns, with evidence from the transcript.

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.instruction: List next steps: follow-up questions, materials to send, decisions pending, and their owners.
